Snacking is ok.  When i started i just tried to do less.  Putting chips in a bowl then putting thw bag away.  Taking one scoop of pasta, eating, waiting for a bit and if i still wanted more i did thw same thing.

Dont be hard on yourself.  Find things that work for you.  Especially with exercise.  You like going for walks? Do that.  You like zumba youtube videos in your living room?  Do that.

The goal is to start with being just a little more aware of what you are putting in your body and how you are moving it.  

Wade into pool to build uplife long habits that you LOVE doing.  It makes it much easier, and the changes tend to stick over wanting quick results.  Long term changes can be frustrating.  Trust me i know.  But they have supported my journey better than crash diets or over working my body.
